race.comment: SACROSANCT (6) sets the standard after two solid runs this campaign, finishing second at this track first-up before closing strongly for second at Illawarra Grange, beaten just under a length on soft ground. Race-fit, gets weight relief from the 59kg she carried last start and looks ready to convert. STONECREST (5) is the clear danger after winning on debut at Gosford as a heavily backed odds-on favourite. He jumps in class but looks to have the profile to go on with it. Blinkers and rails draw are a bonus. BAYLIE'S FOLLY (4) slashing return to get off the mark at Nowra, then handled stronger company, running third in a BM68 at Warwick Farm. Maps well and looks to have genuine claims. HELEN'S WAY (1) had mixed luck in his first Australian prep and returns from a lengthy break. Since fitted with the two trials and look for a strong showing.
